reviews.author: SuburbanMomof2kids
reviews.title: It's more than a library
reviews.text: Definitely a unique and fun experience. Once inside, the fresh wood furniture smell is evident. We got bracelets as part of the experience for interactive exploring. Make sure you use it to tap the many photo ops and seek and find animals to log your own personal online journal. Once you take your photo at the beginning, it's used to create these Theodore Roosevelt period, black and white portraits. Pretty cool. Each exhibit is educational and entertaining. Lots to see and take in. Very awe inspiring and showcased Roosevelt's accomplishments and contributions to America's greatness. He had so many inspiring quotes that were used throughout the library. It took us 3 hours easily and we don't think we covered all. Must visit before it gets too popular. It got very crowded as people came and stayed. Food wasn't great, maybe they will improve. Souvenirs were pricey even for a postcard. Surrounding canyon sights were magnificent. Glad we drove 4 hours from Mt Rushmore to get there.

reviews.author: Abby H
reviews.title: First Time Visitor
reviews.text: Wow! What an experience. I was gifted tickets without any prior knowledge of what to expect. I have visited many museums, and this by far, exceeded my expectations. The interactive exhibits made it engaging for young children and an incredible educational experience. In no time, three hours had escaped us. If you have mobility issues, I highly recommend being dropped off at the front entrance and riding the golf cart to the front door. Most likely, there will be a line to stand in even if you have purchased tickets ahead of time. Once you make it through the first exhibit, there is adequate seating options to rest at before venturing to other exhibits. Try to bring as little as possible so your hands won't be tied up and you can easily access the interactive exhibits. There are clean restrooms available upon walking in and within the main area. Food is available on site too. Plan in your budget to find something at the gift shop! A lot of great options to find a keepsake of your experience.

reviews.author: PhillipABukowski
reviews.title: Overcrowded during peak season
reviews.text:
The library is a 10/10 experience but they're overselling the tickets for admission and the place is packed with bottlenecks at all of the interactive exhibits.

If you can come during "off season" it'll be absolutely amazing.

Also the gift shop is brutally overpriced. And the bathrooms are too small for the crowds. Beware.

reviews.author: Abby H.
reviews.text: An absolute must see. Richly preserved history and interactive AI exhibits. Excellent way to instill a love for learning and history.

reviews.author: Mayberrys
reviews.title: Wonderful trip to Theodore Roosevelt library
reviews.text:
The Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library in Medora, North Dakota, is one of the state's premier attractions and sits on a bluff overlooking Theodore Roosevelt National Park.

The exhibits tell Theodore Roosevelt's life story, from a rancher in the Badlands to the 26th U.S. president.

Interactive galleries, artifacts, and multimedia experiences.
Stunning architecture designed to blend into the Badlands landscape.

Scenic walking trails and overlooks with panoramic views.

reviews.author: Becky W
reviews.title: Excellent!! Do nit miss
reviews.text:
Excellent. Over the top exhibits. So interactive. Families and children were just loving it. We spent four hours there and could've stayed longer. The design is so beautiful.
When you go, you receive a bracelet and you enter your name and email. Then at the exhibit you can scan your bracelet. It makes pictures of you and has you do quizzes and send them all to your email after you leave. It is so good.

reviews.author: Mary K
reviews.title: AN ABSOLUTE MUST SEE!!!
reviews.text:
I was NOT expecting the experience this library provided!!
The thought in everything this attraction has to offer is outstanding!!!!
It also imposes YOUR face in multiple interactive photo shoots (in time period clothing) and emails you the results. You are given a wrist band that activates the interactive displays and photos. The photos are then sent to your email.
SO much to see and LEARN
GO, GO, GO! You will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: Luv2sing4U
reviews.title: Educational experience but they're still working on some issues.
reviews.text: The library is beautiful. The problem is getting to the library because the signage is so poorly done. Our friend requires a handicap parking space for which there was absolutely zero signs to indicate how to get there. We asked one of the employees where those parking spaces were and she said that the pavement is marked, but when people parked over them, no one else even realizes that they are there. Once you park, it is still quite a hike to get up to the entrance to the library. I only saw one or two shuttles that were available to take people who needed additional assistance to get from the limited parking area up to the entrance. After you get to the entrance you get in a line and wait to be sent through a freestanding scanner. The scanner later blew over & broke when a wind storm blew through. Once you're cleared to go in, there's another line to get in to go through to get your ticket scanned. Then you're given the opportunity to sign up with your wristband to be able to take pictures of yourself throughout the library. If you decide to go, I recommend planning a full day in order to stop and read every single display that they have. It's very interesting & educational but it's also very time-consuming and daunting, especially if there's large crowds. The observation of the four of us in our group decided that we much more enjoyed the Bush library we have been through in Texas.

reviews.author: Allen T
reviews.title: Don't pass it by
reviews.text: The very model of a modern presidential museum (not really a library). Probably the best single attraction in North Dakota....the state should promote it heavily. Building, exhibits and connection to the landscape are outstanding, even if I might have a few quibbles with the museum's interpretations of TR's career. And who doesn't love those AI-generated photos they send you!

reviews.author: Sleepyscags
reviews.title: Great Visit To The TR Presidental Library - Don't Miss It
reviews.text: We loved the TR Library! Travelled with 2 young adults and they found it fascinating. The exhibits were informative and hands on. The library is very interactive with fun AI engagement. There is lots to explore so allow at least 3 hours there. The food in the cafe was also great, it hit the spot after a long drive to get there. If you're in the Medora, ND area, don't miss the TR Presidential Library.

reviews.author: Noel F.
reviews.text: The cost of admission here is worth every single penny. The building is beautiful, and it's unlike any museum I've ever experienced - top 5 for sure. There are so many interactive experiences throughout!! I don't want to spoil any fun, but there's a bracelet you wear with an RFID tag (think Disney magic band) that allows for activations throughout the exhibits. There's immersive videos, too, as well as an AI Teddy Roosevelt you can ask questions to (a partnership with Microsoft). It's genuinely just as fun as it is educational. I left with a new appreciation for what he did for conservation in the USA and a deeper understanding of his presidency and his life. The staff members were friendly if not a tad frazzled, given the heavy crowds. I'm not a history person but this was a highlight of my trip to North Dakota for sure.

reviews.author: Maria Aimen J.
reviews.text:
Unfortunately, we were not able to even visit the library, because, apparently, you had to buy tickets in advance.
We had parked our car, and went through security, then come to find out that you need to buy tickets to visit a library. I had no idea, no libraries near us do that. Nor do any libraries I've ever been to. Apparently all of the reviews that I read online did not mention that you had to purchase a ticket. I asked, how much it was, and one of the security girls had to ask the other one, who said it was $26 (check online if you want to confirm). I figured since we already drove up here, I would buy them, so I told her that I would be purchasing them for my family, and she said that they already had sold out yesterday. So that was a letdown.

The outdoor of the library was beautiful. You could tell that everything looks brand new. There were people singing near the rocking chairs, although they were singing pretty explicit things with families around. I'm not sure how it is with those people, but had my parents been with me, like theirs were with them, it would make me really uncomfortable to be with my parents and hear those songs.
I would have given them five stars even if I wasn't able to go into the library if workers do not have to ask each other how much the price of the tickets are, and those explicit songs. On the plus side, the bathrooms were clean. They also had a water bottle refill fountain right by the bathrooms.

Beautiful architecture but apparently all AI in there.

reviews.author: mel_pink5
reviews.title: A true National treasure!
reviews.text:
Awesome! Just plain awesome. Know when you go to go through the museum in order, it mimics his life story. I think the premise was to get people to wind through a certain way, but the big gallery room kinda confuses the flow. You will move front to back, and side to side as you progress. I think everyone is just so new they are figuring out things.

In addition, the restaurant was closed for an event, and the gift shop only had $12 Cokes. There was one water fountain near the restrooms. They really need to rethink the needs of the customers when they are spending 3+ hours in the museum. Having water readily available, even if it is for purchase, is a must when you are in the Badlands.

There is ample outside space to explore, great walking paths, and rocking chairs to enjoy the view (just need more).

Parking filled up really fast, I hope they will develop more, and a shuttle from the far lots.

All in all, this experience is fantastic, it is terrific for kids, take your time, enjoy the story!

reviews.author: Spokanic
reviews.title: The building steals the show
reviews.text:
An architectural and landscape architectural masterpiece that beautifully complements the Badlands.

The place is a shrine to TR, and exhibits gloss over some of his shortcomings (racism, imperialism) while underplaying some of his greatest achievements (trust busting, labor rights, land conservation, national parks). The building is all about the conservation ethos while exhibits dwell more on conquering Cuba, playing cowboy, adventuring in the Amazon—the Disney version of TR. But it's all pretty fun and engaging.

reviews.author: Susanna C.
reviews.text: This was the first time we visited a presidential library, so we weren't sure what to expect. It was a hot day and we thought it would be a good way to spend the afternoon and escape the heat. We were so delightfully surprised at how fun a presidential library could be! We bought the tickets online and showed up at the scheduled time (2pm). The displays are engaging, thought provoking, educational and fun. They give you. Bracelet with a chip that you can scan at various places, with AI generated images and other activities. While every presidency has ups and downs - we really appreciate that TR created the system that supports our national park system and protects places for our future through the Antiquities Act of 1906.

reviews.author: Carmen T
reviews.title: Put on the top of your bucket list!
reviews.text: I learned about the opening of the library on tv as part of a 250th celebration special. It looked very interesting but we were totally blown away!! We reserved tickets for 12 pm and a 1 pm Deep Dive Specialty tour. We ended up closing the place at 6 pm with so much to see and experience. It had lots of interactive features like designing your own cattle brand, campaign slogan, trivia, find different animals and imax like cozy theater experiences. When you arrive, you take your picture ( I wish I would have smiled) and get a wrist band with a wooden medallion. Any place you see the medallion symbol, you tap on it to interact or display your picture in various scenes associated with TR's life. At the end you get a video that describes you based on your interactions. I was part of the wolf clan and a guide. So magical and moving. Hands down the best museum I have been to here and abroad!!

reviews.author: Melodycthomas
reviews.title: What a phenomenal experience!!
reviews.text: This newly opened presidential museum makes full use of A.I. You get a wrist band with a chip in it. You check in at a station, enter your information and get a picture taken. Then as you go through the museum, you check in at different stations using your wrist band. At each of the different phases of Theodore Roosevelt's life (Navy, politics, police, explorer, etc.), a sepia colored picture is produced of you in period costume. Not only do you learn all about this most famous president, but you interact with systems that make your tour that much more interesting. After you leave the museum, you get a personal letter from TR and all your pictures. We have been to many presidential museums. This is, by far, the best yet. Don't miss it!!

reviews.author: R B
reviews.title: Theodore Roosevelt Presidental Library. Great experience
reviews.text: The library is worth th3 visit. Make a day of it. We were there a few hours and still did could have stayed longer, but it was very busy. Staff is amazing. Great historical esperience.

reviews.author: Kathy C
reviews.title: Must see
reviews.text: The library was so wonderful. The interactive exhibits were fun and educational. Definitely a stop for whole family. And the area and grounds are stunning. Plan 3 hours at least.

reviews.author: Christy K.
reviews.text: I've seen a lot of museums in my life. In addition to the US Holocaust in Washington DC, this is by far one of the best. You will leave inspired.

reviews.author: derickson74
reviews.title: Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library is a Must See for everyone!
reviews.text: This is a beautiful area of North Dakota to explore. Admission was reasonable for the experience. They give you a bracelet that can activate displays to interact with. you can also get your photo taken at the beginning so you can use your bracelet to insert your photo in different displays. There was a seek and find game too that looked like a lot of fun. We were there for a couple of hours and could have easily stayed much longer. There was so much to see and look at. The displays were great. They have hands-on experience. There's a giftshop and small restaurant. The view from outside the building is amazing. Staff was very friendly. The person that sold us our tickets was a lot of fun. There were quite a few people there but it wasn't crowded. It's suitable for all ages. I think everyone would have a fun time learning about President Roosevelt and history of the area.

reviews.author: Christine S
reviews.title: Worth the Drive!!!
reviews.text: Stunning!! Interactive for people of all ages. So well done. I loved every minute of it. The best $26.00 ever spent!! Plan to spend 2-3 hours minimum there.

reviews.author: Kelly605
reviews.title: Awesome history lesson of TR's life!
reviews.text: Such an awesome place to visit! The way TR's life was shared from birth to death was so cool! The AI exhibits made it so fun for all ages. Beautiful building and outdoor area!

reviews.author: Dave K
reviews.title: Great time and fascinating.
reviews.text: This presidential library was absolutely incredible! We visited with four adults and three kids, ages 6, 8, and 12, and every one of us was completely captivated. There was something to see, learn, and interact with around every corner, making it enjoyable for visitors of all ages. The exhibits are thoughtfully designed with fascinating displays and hands-on experiences that kept everyone engaged. We found ourselves wanting to stop and explore every room, but unfortunately we had to leave sooner than we wanted because we had other plans in Medora. This was easily one of the highlights of our trip, and it's one of those places you could visit more than once and still discover something new. We're already looking forward to coming back so we can spend more time taking it all in! My only negative is the fact that adults are ages 13 on up. Where in this world is a 13 yr old an adult? Kind of crappy or them to charge this much for. a 13 yr old.

reviews.author: LaVia M
reviews.title: Worth coming back!
reviews.text: The interactive exhibits are wonderful. Teens were interested as well. We had a 45 minute tour but one needn't have done it…the displays are instructive enough. We ate lunch (egg salad+) there, as we were there 5 hours in total. [Not bad for two duffers.] We are planning a return trip.

reviews.author: Tmamer
reviews.title: Incredible experience
reviews.text: A beautiful setting with incredible views and walking paths built into natural environment. The building was so beautifully designed for all ages. Interactive and AI enhanced experiences that kept everyones attention. Don't skip the registration at the beginning with your picture which creates multiples keepsakes throughout. Register ahead of time to ensure your time slot isn't booked. You can bring in water and cameras. They also have a small restaurant and gift store. Well worth the money!

reviews.author: Rob J
reviews.title: Superb experience
reviews.text:
This is a very well designed, brand new building. It's not even. been a week since opening. It is much more than a library. It's so much more. I would consider it a memorial interactive centre documenting Roosevelts life and times.
The displays are totally interactive and state of the art. We were traveling with an 7 year old and a 9 year old. We spent over 4 hours!!! at the "library". The kids were so engaged and the state of the art exhibits involved multisensory experiences.
The architecture is such that the building blends in with the natural environment.
The experience doesn't end after leaving the library. We all got an email record of our journey throught the museum with photos and videos.
All in all it certainly was worth the 9 hour drive.

reviews.author: Nicole A
reviews.title: Absolutely worth the trip!
reviews.text: Now THIS is a presidential library! The views are spectacular. Not only is it a sight to see in the Badlands, but the technology inside is great for all ages! They did a fabulous job building this and telling his life story. We spent 4 hours there!

reviews.author: mrc282
reviews.title: cowboy turn president 1901-1909
reviews.text:
Theodore Roosevelt is a multifaceted figure: soldier, peacemaker, hunter, conservationist, diplomat, opportunist.

I havent been to many presidential libraries, but this one stands out due to its interactive and AI-powered feature. Despite being the 26th president, his library was just officially completed and inaugurated on 4 July 2026 in conjunction with 250th anniversary of US's independence.

When you enter, you are first given a wrist band that is linked to your name / email / photo. later, within the museum, you will be able to see yourself depicted as various figures during the TR era and interact with TR (or at least its lifelike representation) by scanning against a compass icon.

As the museum just opened, entry is enforced by time slot. There is security check but bottled water/camera/mobile phones/small bag are fine. Make sure you book well in advance online if you are on a tight schedule

reviews.author: N M
reviews.text: Wow! What an amazing museum! I highly recommend stopping in. My kids and even teenager said it was the coolest museum they have ever been to! It is such an interactive experience. Great for all ages! The younger ones enjoyed finding all the … [truncated on page]

reviews.author: Maria Elwan
reviews.text: We had a great time visiting the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library in Medora North Dakota. Highly interactive exhibits. Great educational experience for kids. Worth setting some time aside to visit the library if you are anywhere near it. Most people spend 2-4 hours there. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Brent Clair
reviews.text: Wow this place is amazing. Great architecture and the way this place is built into the landscape. Allowing amazing views and the ability to walk on the roof for even greater views the area. Nice souvenir shop and presetation on the life … [truncated on page]
